description: Five transient HTTP 503 / No capacity model-runtime errors (three search_web flash-lite capacity failures and two subagent 429/quota errors) occurred during Phase 0 design.
resolution: Logged strictly as a runtime model-capacity incident; architectural specification completed directly without modifying system design.
root_cause: Upstream model capacity / quota exhaustion on external inference endpoints.
prevention_actions: Enforce fallback chains per model_class in 12_MODEL_ROUTING/routing_table.json
Distinguish runtime provider capacity incidents from architectural defects
